'''Fishing treasure''' is the most valuable category of [[fishing]] loot. It can only be caught when the bobber is in open water. Its weight is 5 with quality +2, so the chance per catch is 5% with no luck and 11.34% with {{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} III in a biome with fish.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing.json}}</ref>

== Loot ==
Several entries have a quality, so Luck of the Sea shifts the odds toward chests and [[Crystal Heart]]s.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/treasure.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Item !! Count !! Weight !! Quality !! No luck !! Luck of the Sea I !! II !! III
|-

|-
| {{ItemLink|Hell-Bound Book}} || 1 || 10 || 0 || 16.39% || 15.62% || 14.93% || 14.29%
|-

|-

| {{ItemLink|Crystal Heart}} || 1 || 2 || +2 || 3.28% || 6.25% || 8.96% || 11.43%

|}

* The fishing rod is enchanted as if at level 30 and has 0–25% of its durability used up.
* The book is enchanted at level 30, giving a Hell-Bound Book.
* The goat horn can be any of the regular goat horn sounds.
* The chest is a chest item that holds a buried treasure loot table. When placed, it contains 2–4 [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]] (more with luck), 2 rolls of treasure ores (raw copper, raw gold, lapis lazuli, raw iron or raw diamonds in large stacks), a 1 in 6 chance of 2 coast armor trim templates, a chance of copper, iron, gold or diamond nautilus armor, and a 2 in 3 chance of a sacred text ([[Paradise Lost]] or [[The Divine Comedy]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/chests/fishing/treasure.json}}</ref>

The developer made treasure rarer in 1.10 so that players who don't enjoy fishing don't feel pushed into it for loot.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=I want people who like fishing to be rewarded, I don't want people who don't enjoy fishing to put up with it just to get loot.}}</ref>
